description: This file defines the EventManager class responsible for managing calendar and video events, including creation, updating, rescheduling, and deletion, integrating with various calendar and CRM services within a booking system.

classes.name: EventManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing booking-related calendar and video events, including creation, updating, rescheduling, and deletion, with integrations to various calendar and CRM services.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes EventManager with user credentials, sorting them into calendar, video, and CRM credentials.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates calendar and video events for a booking, handling location processing and fallback logic.

methods.name: updateLocation
methods.description: Updates the location of an existing event, including associated calendar and video events.

methods.name: reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules an existing booking, updating or deleting previous events as needed.

methods.name: cancelEvent
methods.description: Cancels a booking by deleting associated events and meetings.

methods.name: deleteEventsAndMeetings
methods.description: Deletes calendar and video events and meetings based on booking references.

methods.name: createAllCalendarEvents
methods.description: Creates calendar events across multiple calendar services, with fallback logic.

methods.name: getVideoCredentialByCalendarEvent
methods.description: Retrieves appropriate video credential based on event location.

methods.name: createVideoEvent
methods.description: Creates a video meeting event using credentials.

methods.name: updateAllCalendarEvents
methods.description: Updates all calendar events associated with a booking.

methods.name: createAllCRMEvents
methods.description: Creates CRM events for a booking.

methods.name: updateAllCRMEvents
methods.description: Updates CRM events associated with a booking.

methods.name: getAppOptionsFromEventMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves app options based on event metadata.

methods.name: extractServerUrlFromCredential
methods.description: Extracts server URL from a CalDAV credential.

methods.name: extractServerUrlFromDestination
methods.description: Extracts server URL from a destination calendar.

methods.name: credentialMatchesDestination
methods.description: Checks if credential server URL matches destination calendar server URL.
